verdict.rationale: Fathom documents admin visibility into shared content: admins can be granted view access to all shared calls across teams, and an admin-only endpoint lists users with their permissions. Meetings can also be shared to a team, and folders exist for collaboration. Missing for 10: evidence of private-by-default notes, granular link-level sharing permissions, folder/workspace-level permission controls, and an admin report or audit of what has been shared, plus any independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, sharing is controlled — private-by-default notes, granular link/folder/workspace permissions, and admin visibility into what's shared
